question: How do embedder size, chunk size, the reranker and hybrid search, and their interactions, change retrieval quality on FinanceBench, FreshStack LangChain (full public corpus), BioASQ and Legal RAG Bench (exploratory) with pinned local models, and how does chunk size change answer faithfulness and correctness at the embedder and reranker sizes chosen on half A? preregistration.md governs (amendment A4).
decision: The first fellowship paper cites these numbers; the experiment changes no production default, and any setting change it suggests goes to a separate proposal.

hypotheses.statement: within scope S (preregistration.md section 2), a bigger embedder ranks gold units higher: rows 1 (4B minus 0.6B) and 2 (8B minus 4B), nDCG@10, directional; a step holds when its row counts on at least 2 of 3 core datasets; H1 holds in full when both steps hold, in part when one does
within scope S (preregistration.md section 2), the reranker raises nDCG@10: row 3 (mean of the three reranker sizes minus off), directional; holds when row 3 counts on at least 2 of 3 core datasets
within scope S (preregistration.md section 2), hybrid search raises nDCG@10: row 4 (hybrid on minus off), directional; holds as H2

within scope S (preregistration.md section 2), reranker plus hybrid beats each alone (simple effects, not an interaction test): rows 5 (both on minus reranker only) and 6 (both on minus hybrid only), nDCG@10, directional; holds on a dataset when both rows count there, and overall on at least 2 of 3 core datasets; the interaction is reported descriptively with its interval
within scope S (preregistration.md section 2), a bigger reranker ranks better: rows 7 (4B minus 0.6B) and 8 (8B minus 4B), reranker-on setups, nDCG@10, directional; holds as H1

within scope S (preregistration.md section 2), chunk size changes retrieval: rows 9 (1,024 minus 512) and 10 (2,048 minus 1,024), two-sided; endpoint evidence_recall_20k with any-page credit on FinanceBench and nDCG@10 on FreshStack; holds when the same row (9 or 10) counts with the same sign on FinanceBench and on FreshStack; opposite signs are reported as a dataset-dependent effect; BioASQ is a sanity check and Legal RAG Bench is exploratory

within scope S (preregistration.md section 2), a bigger embedder gains more from bigger chunks: row 11, (8B at 2,048 minus 8B at 512) minus (0.6B at 2,048 minus 0.6B at 512), marginal over reranker and hybrid, directional, on the H6 endpoints; holds when row 11 counts on both FinanceBench and FreshStack; BioASQ is a sanity check and Legal RAG Bench is exploratory; expected to be underpowered
hypotheses.null: the difference of differences is zero

hypotheses.statement: within scope S (preregistration.md section 2), chunk size changes GLM-5.3 faithfulness on factual claims and Ragas AnswerCorrectness in the 12 crossed setups, where context length grows with chunk size: rows 12 to 13 (faithfulness) and 14 to 15 (correctness), 1,024 minus 512 and 2,048 minus 1,024, marginal over reranker and hybrid, two-sided, all questions, 3 runs averaged per question; per outcome, holds when the same row counts with the same sign on FinanceBench and on FreshStack (open item O6); BioASQ rows are sanity checks; faithfulness is expected to fall as chunks grow; Legal RAG Bench is exploratory; FinanceBench number match is secondary; confirmatory

within scope S (preregistration.md section 2), chunk size changes faithfulness and correctness when evidence is held at 20,480 Qwen3 tokens: rows 16 to 17 (faithfulness) and 18 to 19 (correctness), c1024-t20k minus c512-t20k and c2048-t20k minus c1024-t20k, two-sided, at reranker on and hybrid on with the chosen sizes (conditional on that cell); holds as H8a (same row, same sign, on FinanceBench and on FreshStack); 'chunk size itself changes X' is claimed only when H8b holds for outcome X; confirmatory

decision_rule: preregistration.md sections 7 to 9 govern. No mixed model. For row k and question q, the contrast score d_qk is the mean of q's scores over the cells at the first level minus the mean over the cells at the second level (equal cell weights; answer scores averaged over 3 runs first); the estimate is the plain mean of d_qk over questions. FreshStack, BioASQ and Legal: the decision test is defined by its closed form (preregistration.md section 9 point 3): estimate = mean of d_qk; variance = sum of squared residuals x (n / (n minus 1)) squared / n squared (Mancl and DeRouen bias-reduced sandwich, intercept only, one row per cluster); t reference on n minus 1 degrees of freedom for the p-value and interval. Implementation: statsmodels GEE of d_qk on an intercept (Gaussian, identity link, independence working correlation, clusters = questions, cov_type bias_reduced); a known-answer test checks it against the closed form, and the closed form is used if they differ. FinanceBench: the decision p-value and 95% interval come from a document-level sign-flip permutation test (100,000 draws, seed 20261101). Holm (alpha 0.05) within families fixed now: FinanceBench 19 rows, FreshStack 19 rows, BioASQ 8 rows (rows 1 to 8; rows 9 to 19 are sanity checks, rows 12 to 19 pending open item O6); Legal RAG Bench has no family and is exploratory. A row whose measure fails its gate, or that the differential-error rule makes exploratory, stays in its family with p = 1 and is reported as not testable. A directional row counts when the Holm-adjusted p is below 0.05 and the estimate has the predicted sign; a two-sided row counts when the Holm-adjusted p is below 0.05. Hypotheses hold by the rule in each statement (H1 to H5: 2 of 3 core datasets; H6, H7, H8a and H8b: FinanceBench and FreshStack). A two-sided hypothesis holds only when the same row counts with the same sign on every dataset its rule needs; opposite signs are reported as a dataset-dependent effect and the hypothesis does not hold. Fixed search settings: similarity_threshold 0.0, metadata extraction disabled, exact dense search with no approximate vector index, chunk overlap 15% (77, 154 and 307 tokens). Search scoring: top 100 chunks (rerank pool 100, fetch_k 100) collapsed to distinct units and cut at 10; FinanceBench nDCG@10 gives a chunk its first page (any-page credit is a sensitivity); evidence_recall_20k gives any-page credit (first-page credit is a sensitivity). Registered sensitivity checks, never decisive: paired permutation by question (10,000 shuffles, seed 20261101) on FreshStack and BioASQ; GEE with document clusters on FinanceBench. A non-significant result means no difference was detected; there is no equivalence claim and no TOST.
baseline: none: full factorial of embedder x chunk size x reranker x hybrid (72 search setups per dataset); e4b-c1024-roff-hoff is the reference cell of the G2 rebuild check only
candidate: 72 search setups e<0.6b|4b|8b>-c<512|1024|2048>-r<off|0.6b|4b|8b>-h<off|on>; 15 answer setups (12 crossed plus token-matched c512-t20k, c1024-t20k and c2048-t20k; the third added by A3), chosen on half A, at the embedder and reranker sizes chosen by the pre-registered selection rule (pooled over the three core datasets, amendment A3); index cost and configuration hash as defined in preregistration.md section 14.1

gates.value: point estimate, per checker, 450 claims from answers to all questions (both halves)
point estimate, per core dataset, 50 half-B answers

amendments.summary: Full-factorial redesign agreed with the operator before the freeze. Replaces the six one-factor arms (documents-profile-4b, embedding-0.6b, embedding-8b, reranker-off, chunking-off, hybrid) with embedder (0.6B, 4B, 8B) x chunk size (512, 1024, 2048, overlap 15%) x reranker (off, Qwen3-Reranker 0.6B, 4B, 8B) x hybrid (off, BM25 on): 72 search setups per dataset. Adds Legal RAG Bench (100 questions, exploratory) and uses the 203 public FreshStack queries (was 223). Drops MiniLM, the chunking-off arm, Granite Guardian (runtime entry judge-granite-guardian removed) and hypothesis H-CC. Hypotheses H1 to H7 (search) and H8 (answer stage) replace the five per-arm hypotheses. Answer stage: 12 setups at the embedder and reranker sizes chosen by a pre-registered rule, 3 runs each. Budget: the $250 cap is replaced by an estimate of about $555 and a ceiling of $830. The three Qwen3-Reranker GGUF files are pinned in the runtime block after the test pod check (Exp 35 task 4A.3). One GPU type for every main-run pod, chosen before the freeze from a fixed timing job on RTX 4090, L40S and H100 by the rule in protocol.md section 0.8a; the 9 indexes build on parallel pods of that type.

amendments.summary: Operator answers to the A1 questions: FreshStack corpus without the 15 continuity documents and the overlay runbook; BioASQ and Legal passages written as .md so all four datasets count the pinned Qwen3 tokenizer; Ragas 0.4.3 AnswerCorrectness on all four datasets against reference answers, validated on 100 operator-labelled answers (seed 20261113, counts for H8 at pooled kappa >= 0.60), plus the FinanceBench number match; one answer round (answer.context_window 131072 characters, answer.max_rounds 1); one search run per setup. Budget estimate $555, ceiling $830.

Methods review fixes approved by the operator: unit-level scoring (top 100 chunks collapsed to distinct units, cut at 10; FinanceBench page credit by first page); token-matched control (512x40, 1024x20 vs 2048x10) in search (evidence_recall_20k) and answer stage (2 extra setups, 14 in all; 15 after A3); H6 confirmatory on FinanceBench and FreshStack only, BioASQ sanity check, Legal exploratory throughout; one linear mixed model per dataset (statsmodels MixedLM) with planned contrasts and Holm across H1-H8, cross-dataset rule 2 of 3 confirmatory datasets, FinanceBench bootstrap by document; MDE from data before the freeze; split-half selection (seed 20261115, select on half A, answer headlines on half B); human validation by labellers L1 and L2 (400 L1 items, 30% by L2, kappa with intervals); closed-book run on all 1,160 questions; returned model and provider recorded per hosted call; reranker SHA-256 pins after a Spearman >= 0.95 check on 200 seeded pairs per size; OSF pre-registration at the freeze; only nDCG@10 primary; 0.045/0.055 sensitivity re-test dropped. Budget estimate $640, ceiling $960.

Answer model stays deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 on the API; statsmodels in the stats dependency group. Budget estimate $650, ceiling $975.

Final budget estimate $650, ceiling $975.

amendments.summary: Selection rule amended: the pooled score for embedder and reranker-size choice uses the three core datasets only (Legal excluded). Adds a four-factor pick on half A for Part 2 (chunk size, reranker on or off, hybrid on or off; pooled mean nDCG@10 over the three core datasets; ties within 0.01 go to reranker off, then hybrid off, then lowest index cost, then smaller chunk). The cell's configuration hash goes to OSF before half B opens. Part 2 (RAGFlow) runs on half B only, once per system, with its own protocol (C1, C2) and its own human labels. Experiment 35 label counts are unchanged. Clarified after the PR 209 review (2026-11-13, no change of design): H1 to H8 nulls are zero effects, the minimum detectable effect is for power planning only; the G2 rebuild check runs before any search writes into the shared output folder. PR 209 clarification (2026-11-13): (a) token-matched control: a 15th answer setup c2048-t20k (20,480-token cut at 2,048-token chunks, reranker on, hybrid on) sits beside c512-t20k and c1024-t20k; the c2048 x 10 factorial cell is unchanged; H8 token-matched comparison uses the three -t20k setups; 15 answer setups x 3 runs; G1 covers 15; answer stage cost rises about 1/14 (about $40: $24 hosted plus about 18 pod hours), estimate about $690, ceiling stays $975. (b) Part 2 FinanceBench C1 unit: page level for every question and both systems; gate that RAGFlow returns page numbers on a seeded sample; fallback document level for every question and both systems if the gate fails; other unit as labelled sensitivity.

amendments.summary: Publication review fixes F1 to F30, approved by the operator on 2026-11-14, and the second-round fixes C1 to C24 ruled on the same day. From A4 on, preregistration.md governs the live design and wins over protocol.md, this file and the OpenSpec changes; earlier amendments are history. Hypotheses: H1 to H7 scoped (scope S) with numbered rows and a holds rule each; H4 named as simple effects; H6, H7, H8a and H8b hold only on FinanceBench and FreshStack (H8a and H8b by open item O6), and a two-sided hypothesis needs the same row with the same sign on every dataset its rule needs; H8 split into H8a (12 crossed setups) and H8b (3 token-matched setups), both confirmatory; every null is a zero effect; Legal RAG Bench exploratory everywhere, H8a and H8b correctness included. Analysis: the mixed model is dropped; per-question contrast scores with an intercept-only GEE (bias-reduced covariance, t on G minus 1) on FreshStack, BioASQ and Legal, and a document-level sign-flip test (100,000 draws, seed 20261101) on FinanceBench; Holm families fixed at 19 (FinanceBench), 19 (FreshStack) and 8 (BioASQ; rows 9 to 19 are sanity checks there), 46 contrasts; a gated row stays in its family with p = 1. Metrics: nDCG@10 is the primary metric of the study; evidence_recall_20k is the confirmatory endpoint for H6 and H7 on FinanceBench (rows 9 to 11) with any-page credit, so both carry primary: true in metrics (first-page credit is a sensitivity); alpha-nDCG@10 is secondary on FreshStack if its nugget labels allow (P3). FreshStack: all 9 indexes rebuilt on the full public LangChain corpus (49,514 documents, pinned revision, P1); the 10,000-document subset is retired. Labels and gates: L1 750 (claim kinds 100, faithfulness 450 at 150 per chunk size from answers to all questions, correctness 200 at 50 per dataset), L2 225 (30%); faithfulness gate per checker (pooled over the core datasets) and correctness gate per core dataset on kappa point estimate (at least 0.60) and lower 95% bound (at least 0.40), plus an AUC check on the continuous correctness score; every gate interval a percentile bootstrap with 10,000 resamples by question and its own seed; differential-error rule on GLM-5.3 in either direction; a length-controlled check on 300 claims. Runs: two closed-book runs (own-knowledge prompt, and the RAG prompt with empty evidence) beside the oracle run; H8a and H8b correctness rows re-run on questions both closed-book runs answer wrongly. Halves and order: FinanceBench split by document, the other datasets by question (seed 20261115); score half A, write selection.json, time-stamp the A3 configuration hash on OSF, then score half B; the RQ1 retrieval headline is the A3 cell on half B. Selection terms: index cost is stored vector values (chunks times embedding dimension) summed over the three core datasets; the configuration hash is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the selected cell's resolved settings plus the halves.json SHA-256. The openai/gpt-6.1-terra cross-check is removed, because no cost estimate included it; its reference entry is deleted. New seeds 20261118 (pilot), 20261119 (length-controlled check) and 20261121 to 20261135 (smoke sample, L2 subsets, gate bootstraps, RAGFlow samples, Part 2 labels; preregistration.md section 16) wait for confirmation (P9); 20261120 (audit) is used only if open item O3 is yes. Budget: estimate about $730 plus the pilot (the full FreshStack build is not timed yet, P2; the pilot cost is projected from P2 and approved before the pod starts), ceiling $975 unchanged. Results-blind drop order at the ceiling: (1) Legal RAG Bench answer generation, (2) the length-controlled check, (3) the closed-book run with the RAG prompt, then stop; E1 has its own ceiling; a run that finishes every confirmatory item after drops is complete with registered drops, each a numbered deviation; no operator choice. Part 2 and E1 get their own estimate and ceiling (P16). The frozen list stays empty until the freeze; the pins table in preregistration.md section 16 fills it (answer-model host, reasoning mode, output cap and context length; judge, classifier and GLM-5.3 settings; query instruction, reranker instruction and hybrid settings; FreshStack and Legal revisions; halves.json and prompt template hashes; the evidence_recall_20k tolerance; the freeze commit and OSF link). These are pre-freeze tasks P1 to P16 (open items O1 to O6 also close before the freeze) and are not filled here. After the freeze, every change is a dated, numbered deviation, added to this list and uploaded to OSF.
